title: With New AI Governance Organization, China Seeks to Formalize Its Global AI Influence
notes: Named-author analysis at a reputable policy outlet; factual claims attributed to WAIC 2026 keynote and the July 16 signing; interpretive passages are the author's assessment. Cited for WAICO founding details, signatory count, and the 5,000-training / cooperation-center / MAZU pledges under Social.
claims: WAICO formally established July 16, 2026, headquartered in Shanghai
Xi Jinping delivered the WAIC 2026 keynote in person on July 17, 2026 (first in-person since 2018 launch)

29 countries signed the WAICO establishment agreement on July 16, 2026 (list: Algeria, Cameroon, Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Lesotho, Mozambique, Oman, Senegal, South Africa, Cambodia, China, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Pakistan, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, Belarus, Russia, Serbia, Brazil, Cuba, Nicaragua, Venezuela)
China pledged 5,000 AI training opportunities for developing countries over five years
China will establish AI cooperation centers with ASEAN, AU, League of Arab States, CELAC, SCO, and BRICS
China will invite 30 countries to use its AI-powered meteorological warning system MAZU
WAICO idea proposed by Li Qiang at 2025 WAIC; reiterated in the 2026-2030 Five-Year Plan
